items.exampleEn: The concert was hugely popular with young people.
items.exampleZh: 這場演唱會非常受年輕人歡迎。

items.exampleEn: The hills were densely covered with trees.
items.exampleZh: 山丘上長滿了茂密的樹木。

items.exampleEn: The new phone is only five millimeters thick.
items.exampleZh: 這支新手機只有五毫米厚。

items.exampleEn: Please be doubly careful on the icy road.
items.exampleZh: 在結冰的路上請加倍小心。

items.exampleEn: The country keeps a stockpile of rice for emergencies.
items.exampleZh: 這個國家儲備了稻米以備緊急時使用。

items.exampleEn: The bank offers micro loans to people who want to start a small business.
items.exampleZh: 這家銀行提供微型貸款給想創業的人。

items.exampleEn: Spread the butter thickly on the bread.
items.exampleZh: 在麵包上厚厚地塗一層奶油。

items.exampleEn: He likes to wear oversize sweaters in winter.
items.exampleZh: 他冬天喜歡穿寬大的毛衣。

items.sentenceEn: Snow fell thickly all night, so the roads were closed.
items.sentenceZh: 雪下了一整夜、積得很厚，所以道路封閉了。

items.audioEn: Oversize bags must be checked in at the counter, not carried onto the plane.
items.audioZh: 特大的行李必須在櫃台托運，不能帶上飛機。
items.questionZh: 特大的行李要怎麼處理？
options: Carry them onto the plane yourself
Check them in at the counter
Pay for them at the gate

items.sentenceEn: The trees in this forest grow so densely that little light reaches the ground.
items.sentenceZh: 這座森林的樹長得非常密，幾乎沒有陽光照到地面。

items.sentenceEn: Winning the prize was doubly exciting because it was my birthday.
items.sentenceZh: 得獎讓我加倍興奮，因為那天剛好是我生日。

items.stemEn: The new film was ____ successful; it earned millions in its first week.
items.stemZh: 這部新電影非常成功；上映第一週就賺了好幾百萬。

items.stemEn: Before the storm, people built up a ____ of water and food.
items.stemZh: 暴風雨來臨前，大家囤積了水和食物。

items.passageEn: Mia runs a micro business from her small apartment in a densely built part of the city. She makes tiny silver earrings, and some are only three millimeters wide. Her earrings have become hugely popular online. Last winter, she worried that the price of silver would rise, so she built a stockpile of it. Her work requires her to be doubly careful, because one small mistake can ruin a whole day's work. Additionally, she sells oversize gift boxes, thickly painted in gold, which her customers love.
items.passageZh: Mia 在城裡建築密集地區的小公寓裡經營一個微型事業。她做很小的銀耳環，有些只有三毫米寬。她的耳環在網路上非常受歡迎。去年冬天，她擔心銀價會上漲，所以囤積了一批銀。她的工作必須加倍小心，因為一個小錯誤就可能毀掉一整天的成果。此外，她也賣特大號的禮物盒，上面塗著厚厚的金色，顧客都很喜歡。

options: 和一枚十元硬幣一樣大

items.promptZh: 這個城市的房子蓋得非常密集。
referenceEn: The houses in this city are very densely built.
In this city, the houses are built extremely densely.
rubricZh: densely 修飾動詞或過去分詞（例如 densely built、densely packed）
「非常」可寫 very、extremely 等；寫 built very close together 意思也對

items.promptZh: 這兩座城市的天氣差異極大。
referenceEn: The weather in the two cities is hugely different.
These two cities have hugely different weather.
rubricZh: hugely 可放形容詞前或修飾動詞，表示「極其」（例如 hugely different、differs hugely 等）
「天氣差異極大」可寫，例如 the weather is hugely different、have hugely different weather 等
